meta.name: validating-api-responses
meta.description:
Validate API responses against schemas to ensure contract compliance and data integrity.
Use when ensuring API response correctness.
Trigger with phrases like "validate responses", "check API responses", or "verify response format".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动核对接口返回数据是否符合格式要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常需要确认接口返回的数据格式正确
copy.tagline_en: Validate API responses against schemas automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure API responses match expected schemas

howto.what: 装好后,Claude能按OpenAPI和JSON Schema规范校验API响应,识别多余字段、类型不匹配、缺少必填字段、空值及格式错误,并生成覆盖率与schema漂移报告。
howto.when: 当你说“validate responses”“check API responses”“verify response format”等触发词,或要求确保API响应正确时,该技能会触发。

say.text: 检查这个接口的响应是否符合OpenAPI规范
say.note: Claude会提取schema并逐项校验响应字段

say.text: 校验这些API返回数据里有没有多余字段
say.note: 在strict模式下发现违规会报告

say.text: 帮我生成响应验证中间件和契约测试
say.note: 输出可运行的middleware与测试套件

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to validate API responses against OpenAPI and JSON Schema specs, detecting undocumented fields, type mismatches, missing required fields, nulls, and format violations, and to generate coverage and schema-drift reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'validate responses', 'check API responses', or 'verify response format', or when ensuring API response correctness.

say_en.text: Check if this endpoint's response matches the OpenAPI spec.
say_en.note: Claude extracts the schema and validates each field.

say_en.text: Validate these API responses for any extra fields.
say_en.note: It reports violations if running in strict mode.

say_en.text: Generate response validation middleware and contract tests.
say_en.note: Outputs runnable middleware and test suite.
